name: Vinson Electric
old_description: We decided years ago that customer satisfaction will be our #1 priority, and we have built a successful business on that foundation principle. Dedicated to service and product knowledge, we are confident that our team will earn your business over and over again. Call us, send us an email, or stop by our location to see how Vinson Electric Supply Inc. can assist you with all of your electrical and lighting needs!
about:
Vinson Electric Supply Inc. operates from Russellville, Arkansas, where it maintains a stocked warehouse and showroom for electrical and lighting products. The company does not publish a founding date or ownership details, but it identifies as a local supplier built on personal service.

The business distributes electrical supplies for both commercial and residential projects. Its facility combines warehouse inventory with a showroom, allowing customers to browse and purchase items on site. No specific product lines, headcount, or volume metrics are disclosed.

Customers include commercial contractors and residential clients in the Russellville area seeking electrical and lighting materials. The company emphasizes walk-in access and product knowledge for trade and DIY buyers alike.

Vinson Electric states that customer satisfaction has been its guiding principle since its early years, with a team dedicated to service and product expertise. The firm positions itself on responsiveness and local availability rather than scale or specialization.
